string_includes.brief: String.prototype.includes：判断从 pos 起是否包含子串 / `String.prototype.includes`: test whether the string contains the substring from `pos` on

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为查找子串，`a[1]` 为起始位置 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the search substring, `a[1]` the start position

string_includes.return: 包含返回 true、否则 false / `true` when found, `false` otherwise
string_includes.note: 起始位置按码点计算并夹到 [0,total]；超过总长直接返回 false / The start index is in code points, clamped to [0,total]; past the end it returns `false`

string_starts_with.brief: String.prototype.startsWith：判断从 pos 起是否以子串开头 / `String.prototype.startsWith`: test whether the string starts with the substring at `pos`

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为前缀子串，`a[1]` 为起始位置 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the prefix, `a[1]` the start position

string_starts_with.return: 是指定前缀返回 true、否则 false / `true` when it is the given prefix, `false` otherwise
string_starts_with.note: 起始位置为负时按 0 处理；比较按字节长度进行 / A negative start is clamped to 0; comparison uses the byte length

string_ends_with.brief: String.prototype.endsWith：判断指定结尾位置之前是否以子串结尾 / `String.prototype.endsWith`: test whether the string ends with the substring before the given end index

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为后缀子串，`a[1]` 为结尾位置（缺省为串长）/ Argument array: `a[0]` is the suffix, `a[1]` the end position (defaults to the length)

string_ends_with.return: 以指定子串结尾返回 true、否则 false / `true` when it ends with the given suffix, `false` otherwise
string_ends_with.note: 结尾位置按码点计算并夹到 [0,total]；不足子串长度时返回 false / The end index is in code points, clamped to [0,total]; `false` when shorter than the suffix

string_at.brief: String.prototype.at：按下标返回一个码点字符 / `String.prototype.at`: return one code-point character by index

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为下标 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the index

string_at.return: 该位置的字符；越界返回 undefined / The character at that position, or `undefined` when out of range
string_at.note: 负下标从串尾回绕；下标按码点计算 / A negative index counts from the end; indices are in code points

object_is_value.brief: Object.is：按 SameValue 语义比较两个值 / `Object.is`: compare two values with SameValue semantics

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]`、`a[1]` 为待比较的两个值 / Argument array: `a[0]` and `a[1]` are the two values to compare

object_is_value.return: 相同返回 true、否则 false / `true` when the two values are the same, `false` otherwise
object_is_value.note: NaN 视为相等，+0 与 -0 视为不等，其余按严格相等 / `NaN` equals `NaN`, `+0` differs from `-0`, everything else uses strict equality

native_regexp_ctor.brief: RegExp 构造器：新建正则对象 / The `RegExp` constructor: create a regular-expression object

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为模式（可为已有正则），`a[1]` 为标志串 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the pattern (may be an existing regex), `a[1]` the flag string

native_regexp_ctor.return: 新的正则对象；传入正则且未给标志时原样返回 / The new regex object; when given a regex and no flags, that same object

set_key.brief: 把值转成 Set 内部使用的字符串键 / Convert a value into the string key used inside a `Set`

params.v: 待转换的值 / Value to convert

set_key.return: 堆分配的键字符串 / A heap-allocated key string
set_key.note: 按类型加前缀以避免冲突（如布尔 `b:true`、对象按指针 `o:%p`）；字符串与数字直接用其字符串形式 / A per-type prefix avoids collisions (`b:true` for booleans, `o:%p` for objects); strings and numbers use their string form

native_set_ctor.brief: Set 构造器：新建 Set（可选从可迭代对象初始化）/ The `Set` constructor: create a `Set`, optionally seeded from an iterable

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为初始可迭代对象 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the initial iterable

native_set_ctor.return: 新的 Set 对象 / The new `Set` object
native_set_ctor.note: 内部用普通对象（`payload_obj`）以字符串键存储成员 / Members are stored in a plain object (`payload_obj`) keyed by string

set_add.brief: Set.prototype.add：向集合加入一个值 / `Set.prototype.add`: add a value to the set

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为待加入的值 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the value to add

set_add.return: 返回 this（集合本身），便于链式调用 / Returns `this` (the set itself) for chaining
set_add.note: 已存在则不改动；无有效集合时原样返回 this / An existing member is left untouched; with no valid set, `this` is returned as-is

set_has.brief: Set.prototype.has：判断集合是否含某值 / `Set.prototype.has`: test whether the set contains a value

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为待查询的值 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the value to look up

set_has.return: 包含返回 true、否则 false / `true` when present, `false` otherwise

set_delete.brief: Set.prototype.delete：从集合删除某值 / `Set.prototype.delete`: remove a value from the set

params.a: 实参数组：`a[0]` 为待删除的值 / Argument array: `a[0]` is the value to remove

set_delete.return: 确实删除返回 true、否则 false / `true` when a member was removed, `false` otherwise

set_clear.brief: Set.prototype.clear：清空集合 / `Set.prototype.clear`: remove all members from the set
set_clear.note: 实现上是更换一个新的空存储数组 / Implemented by swapping in a fresh empty backing array

set_values.brief: Set.prototype.values/keys：返回成员值的可迭代对象 / `Set.prototype.values`/`keys`: return an iterable over member values
set_values.return: 含全部成员值的可迭代对象 / An iterable over all member values
set_values.note: 按内部键顺序遍历；无有效集合时返回空迭代器 / Walks the internal key order; an empty iterator when there is no valid set

map_size_fn.brief: Map/Set 的 size 取值器：返回元素个数 / The `size` getter for `Map`/`Set`: return the element count
map_size_fn.return: 元素个数（数字）/ The element count as a number
map_size_fn.note: Set 数键个数，Map 数存储数组长度 / For a `Set` it counts the keys, for a `Map` the backing array length

map_kind.brief: 校验 thisv 是否为 Map/Set 对象并取出对象指针 / Validate that `thisv` is a `Map`/`Set` object and hand back its object pointer

params.thisv: 调用时的 this 值 / The `this` value of the call
params.out: out:成功后接收对象指针 / On success receives the object pointer

map_kind.return: 是 Map/Set 返回 1、否则 0 / 1 when it is a `Map`/`Set`, otherwise 0

map_keys.brief: Map.prototype.keys：返回键的可迭代对象 / `Map.prototype.keys`: return an iterable over the keys
map_keys.return: 键的可迭代对象 / An iterable over the keys
map_keys.note: 从存储数组按下标取键；非 Map 返回空迭代器 / Keys are read by index from the backing array; an empty iterator for non-maps

map_values.brief: Map.prototype.values：返回值的可迭代对象 / `Map.prototype.values`: return an iterable over the values
map_values.return: 值的可迭代对象 / An iterable over the values
map_values.note: 按内部 `v<i>` 属性取各值；非 Map 返回空迭代器 / Values are read via the internal `v<i>` members; an empty iterator for non-maps

map_entries.brief: Map.prototype.entries：返回 [键,值] 二元组的可迭代对象 / `Map.prototype.entries`: return an iterable of `[key, value]` pairs
map_entries.return: 二元组数组的可迭代对象 / An iterable of two-element arrays
map_entries.note: 每项为 `[k, v]`；非 Map 返回空迭代器 / Each item is `[k, v]`; an empty iterator for non-maps

set_entries.brief: Set.prototype.entries：返回 [值,值] 二元组的可迭代对象 / `Set.prototype.entries`: return an iterable of `[value, value]` pairs
set_entries.return: 二元组数组的可迭代对象 / An iterable of two-element arrays
set_entries.note: 按规范每项的两元素相同；非 Set 返回空迭代器 / Per spec both elements of each pair are the same value; an empty iterator for non-sets

map_set_iter_self.brief: Map/Set 的 `[Symbol.iterator]`：返回对象自身 / `[Symbol.iterator]` for `Map`/`Set`: return the object itself
map_set_iter_self.return: 调用时的 this 值原样返回 / The `this` value is returned unchanged
map_set_iter_self.note: 迭代行为由 `js_iter_len`/`js_iter_at` 提供，共享的 `next` 遍历器驱动它 / Iterator behaviour is supplied by `js_iter_len`/`js_iter_at` and driven by the shared `next` walker

string_iter.brief: 字符串的 `[Symbol.iterator]`：按码点遍历 / `[Symbol.iterator]` on a string: iterate by code point
string_iter.return: 各码点字符的可迭代对象 / An iterable over the per-code-point characters

fresh_proto.brief: 创建一个挂到指定原型下的新原型对象 / Create a new prototype object chained under the given prototype

params.cls: 原型对象的类名（如 `Array`）/ Class name of the prototype object, e.g. `Array`
params.object_proto: 该原型的父原型（可为 NULL）/ Parent prototype, may be `NULL`

fresh_proto.return: 新建的原型对象 / The newly created prototype object

make_ctor.brief: 创建原生构造器并注册为全局 / Create a native constructor and register it as a global

params.name: 构造器名（同时用作全局属性名）/ Constructor name (also used as the global property name)
params.fn: 原生函数实现 / Native function implementation
params.ud: 透传给原生函数的用户数据 / User data passed through to the native function
params.proto: 构造器的 `prototype` 指向的原型对象（可为 NULL）/ The prototype object the constructor's `prototype` points at, may be `NULL`

make_ctor.return: 新建的构造器函数值 / The newly created constructor function value
make_ctor.note: 同时设置函数的 `name`，并在提供 proto 时设置 `prototype` 属性 / Also sets the function's `name` and, when a prototype is given, its `prototype` property

init_prototypes.brief: 创建各内建类型的原型对象并接好原型链 / Create the prototype objects of the builtin types and wire up the prototype chain
init_prototypes.note: 内建原型的父原型为 `Object.prototype`，三个错误原型继承 `Error.prototype` / Builtin prototypes inherit from `Object.prototype`; the three error prototypes inherit from `Error.prototype`

install_object_proto.brief: 给 `Object.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `Object.prototype`

install_function_proto.brief: 给 `Function.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `Function.prototype`

install_array_proto.brief: 给 `Array.prototype` 安装全部数组方法 / Install all array methods on `Array.prototype`
install_array_proto.note: 覆盖增删改、遍历、查找、排序与 `keys`/`values`/`entries`，并设置 `Symbol.iterator` 为自迭代 / Covers mutation, iteration, searching, sorting plus `keys`/`values`/`entries`, and sets `Symbol.iterator` to self-iteration

install_string_proto.brief: 给 `String.prototype` 安装全部字符串方法 / Install all string methods on `String.prototype`
install_string_proto.note: 包含大小写、修剪、填充、分割替换、匹配与 `includes`/`startsWith`/`endsWith`/`at`，并设置 `Symbol.iterator` 为按码点迭代 / Includes case conversion, trimming, padding, split/replace, matching and `includes`/`startsWith`/`endsWith`/`at`, and sets `Symbol.iterator` to code-point iteration

install_number_proto.brief: 给 `Number.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `Number.prototype`

install_bool_proto.brief: 给 `Boolean.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `Boolean.prototype`

install_regex_proto.brief: 给 `RegExp.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `RegExp.prototype`

install_error_protos.brief: 给错误原型族安装方法与 `name`/`message` 默认值 / Install methods and default `name`/`message` on the error prototype family
install_error_protos.note: `Error.prototype` 得到 `toString`；各子错误原型设置各自的 `name` / `Error.prototype` gains `toString`; each derived error prototype gets its own `name`

install_promise_proto.brief: 给 `Promise.prototype` 安装方法 / Install the methods on `Promise.prototype`

install_map_proto.brief: 给 `Map.prototype` 与 `Set.prototype` 安装方法与 size 取值器 / Install methods and the `size` getter on `Map.prototype` and `Set.prototype`
install_map_proto.note: 两者均设 `Symbol.iterator` 为自迭代；Set 的 `keys`/`values` 共用值迭代器 / Both get `Symbol.iterator` set to self-iteration; the `Set` `keys`/`values` share the value iterator

ctor_of.brief: 从全局对象按名取回构造器对象 / Look up a constructor object on the global object by name
ctor_of.return: 全局对象上该名的对象指针，不存在则为 NULL / The object pointer stored under that global name, or `NULL`

install_object_ctor.brief: 安装 `Object` 构造器与其静态方法 / Install the `Object` constructor and its static methods
install_object_ctor.note: 静态方法含 `keys`/`values`/`entries`/`assign`/`create`/`defineProperty` 等，`is` 单独用 `object_is_value` 注册 / Statics include `keys`/`values`/`entries`/`assign`/`create`/`defineProperty` etc.; `is` is registered separately with `object_is_value`

install_array_ctor.brief: 安装 `Array` 构造器与其静态方法 / Install the `Array` constructor and its static methods

install_string_ctor.brief: 安装 `String` 构造器与其静态方法 / Install the `String` constructor and its static methods

install_number_ctor.brief: 安装 `Number` 构造器、静态方法与常量 / Install the `Number` constructor, its static methods and constants
install_number_ctor.note: 含 `isInteger`/`isFinite`/`isNaN`/`isSafeInteger`、`parseInt`/`parseFloat` 及 `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`/`NaN` 等常量 / Includes `isInteger`/`isFinite`/`isNaN`/`isSafeInteger`, `parseInt`/`parseFloat` and constants such as `MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`/`NaN`

install_error_ctors.brief: 安装 `Error` 及其子类构造器 / Install the `Error` constructor and its subclasses
install_error_ctors.note: 含 `Error`、`TypeError`、`RangeError`、`SyntaxError`、`ReferenceError`，均用 `error_ctor` 并以名字作 `ud` / Covers `Error`, `TypeError`, `RangeError`, `SyntaxError` and `ReferenceError`, all using `error_ctor` with the name as `ud`

install_promise_ctor.brief: 安装 `Promise` 构造器与其静态方法 / Install the `Promise` constructor and its static methods

install_set_statics.brief: 在 `Set` 构造器对象上安装静态方法 / Install static methods on the `Set` constructor object
install_set_statics.note: 按规范 `values`/`keys`/`entries` 均指向值迭代器 / Per spec `values`/`keys`/`entries` all point at the value iterator

install_map_set_ctors.brief: 安装 `Map` 与 `Set` 构造器 / Install the `Map` and `Set` constructors
install_map_set_ctors.note: 随后调用 `install_set_statics` 补上 Set 的静态方法 / Followed by `install_set_statics` to add the `Set` statics

install_symbol_ctor.brief: 安装 `Symbol` 构造器、内置符号与方法 / Install the `Symbol` constructor, well-known symbols and methods
install_symbol_ctor.note: 注册 `iterator`/`toStringTag`/`asyncIterator` 内置符号，并把 `for` 与原型 `toString` 接上 / Registers the `iterator`/`toStringTag`/`asyncIterator` symbols and wires up `for` and the prototype `toString`

install_math_fn_table.brief: 按表把 Math 函数安装到 Math 对象上 / Install the `Math` functions onto the math object from a table

params.math: 目标 `Math` 对象 / Target `Math` object

install_math_fn_table.note: 表中最后一项 `ud` 用来区分 `Math.max`/`Math.min`；`log1p` 等扩展函数用 `MF_*` 选择码作 `ud` / The trailing `ud` distinguishes `Math.max`/`Math.min`; extra functions like `log1p` carry an `MF_*` selector as `ud`

install_math_consts.brief: 把数学常量安装到 Math 对象上 / Install the mathematical constants onto the math object

params.math: 目标 `Math` 对象 / Target `Math` object

install_math.brief: 创建并注册全局 `Math` 对象 / Create and register the global `Math` object
install_math.note: 先建对象并设类名，再装函数表与常量 / Builds the object, sets its class name, then installs the function table and constants

install_json.brief: 创建并注册全局 `JSON` 对象 / Create and register the global `JSON` object

install_global_functions.brief: 在全局对象上安装全局函数与常量 / Install the global functions and constants on the global object
install_global_functions.note: 含 `parseInt`/`parseFloat`/`isNaN`/`isFinite`、URI 编解码、`NaN`/`Infinity`/`undefined`；`encodeURI` 复用组件编解码并带保留字符标志 / Includes `parseInt`/`parseFloat`/`isNaN`/`isFinite`, the URI codecs and `NaN`/`Infinity`/`undefined`; `encodeURI` reuses the component codec with the reserved-chars flag

install_console.brief: 创建并注册全局 `console` 对象 / Create and register the global `console` object
install_console.note: 各方法共用 `native_console`，`ud` 非空表示写到 stderr / All methods share `native_console`; a non-NULL `ud` selects stderr

install_global_object.brief: 把全部内建构造函数与对象装到全局对象上 / Install all builtin constructors and objects onto the global object
install_global_object.note: 含各构造器、`Math`/`JSON`/`console`、`alert` 与 `globalThis`；日期由 `hpe_js_date_install` 单独安装 / Covers the constructors, `Math`/`JSON`/`console`, `alert` and `globalThis`; `Date` is installed separately by `hpe_js_date_install`

hpe_js_create.brief: 创建并初始化一个 JS 运行时实例 / Create and initialise a JS runtime instance
hpe_js_create.return: 成功返回新实例；内存分配失败返回 NULL / The new instance, or `NULL` when allocation fails
hpe_js_create.note: 依次初始化各原型、全局对象/环境、内建对象与定时器 / Initialises the prototypes, global object/environment, builtins and timers in order

hpe_js_destroy.brief: 销毁 JS 运行时并释放其资源 / Destroy a JS runtime and release its resources
hpe_js_destroy.note: 先卸载 DOM 变更监听，再释放块、定时器与模块链表；`js` 为 NULL 时直接返回 / Uninstalls the DOM mutation sink first, then frees blocks, timers and the module list; returns immediately when `js` is `NULL`

hpe_js_set_global_host.brief: 把宿主对象暴露为全局变量 / Expose a host object as a global

params.name: 全局变量名（如 `document`）/ Global variable name, e.g. `document`
params.ptr: 宿主对象指针 / Host object pointer
params.type: 宿主对象类型标记 / Host object type tag
params.vt: 宿主对象虚表 / Host object vtable

hpe_js_set_global_host.note: 以宿主值形式写入全局对象 / Writes a host value onto the global object

eval_common.brief: `hpe_js_eval`/`hpe_js_eval_module` 的公共实现 / Shared implementation behind `hpe_js_eval` and `hpe_js_eval_module`

params.module: 非 0 时按 ES 模块解析执行 / Non-zero parses and runs the source as an ES module
params.errbuf: out:失败时的错误信息缓冲区 / Error-message buffer filled on failure
params.errbuf_size: 错误缓冲区容量 / Error buffer capacity

eval_common.return: 成功返回 0、失败返回 -1 / 0 on success, -1 on failure
eval_common.note: 用 try 帧捕获异常并写入 errbuf；模块模式下先建立模块环境与命名空间，执行后统一抽取微任务 / Uses a try frame to catch exceptions into `errbuf`; in module mode it builds the module environment and namespace first, then drains microtasks after execution

hpe_js_eval.brief: 以脚本方式执行一段源码 / Execute a piece of source as a script

params.errbuf: out:失败时的错误信息缓冲区 / Error-message buffer filled on failure
params.errbuf_size: 错误缓冲区容量 / Error buffer capacity

hpe_js_eval.return: 成功返回 0、失败返回 -1 / 0 on success, -1 on failure
hpe_js_eval.note: 等价于以非模块方式调用 `eval_common` / Equivalent to calling `eval_common` in non-module mode

hpe_js_eval_module.brief: 以 ES 模块方式执行一段源码 / Execute a piece of source as an ES module

params.dir: 解析相对导入的基准目录（可为空）/ Base directory for resolving relative imports, may be empty
params.errbuf: out:失败时的错误信息缓冲区 / Error-message buffer filled on failure
params.errbuf_size: 错误缓冲区容量 / Error buffer capacity

hpe_js_eval_module.return: 成功返回 0、失败返回 -1 / 0 on success, -1 on failure
hpe_js_eval_module.note: `dir` 非空时先更新当前目录，再以模块方式调用 `eval_common`；命名空间可经 import 访问 / When `dir` is non-empty it is set as the current directory first; the namespace is reachable through imports

hpe_js_call.brief: 从 C 侧按值调用一个可调用对象 / Call a callable value from C

params.callee: 被调用的可调用值（如事件处理函数）/ The callable value to call, e.g. an event handler
params.thisv: 调用时的 this 值 / The `this` value of the call
params.args: 实参数组 / Actual argument array

hpe_js_call.return: 成功返回 0、运行时错误返回 -1 / 0 on success, -1 on runtime error
hpe_js_call.note: 运行时错误打印到 stderr；`argc` 为 0 时 `thisv`/`args` 可为 NULL；调用后抽取微任务 / Runtime errors go to stderr; `thisv`/`args` may be `NULL` when `argc` is 0; microtasks are drained after the call

hpe_js_call_value.brief: 从 C 侧调用可调用对象并返回其结果值 / Call a callable value from C and return its result value

params.callee: 被调用的可调用值 / The callable value to call
params.thisv: 调用时的 this 值 / The `this` value of the call
params.args: 实参数组 / Actual argument array

hpe_js_call_value.return: 调用结果值；`js` 为空或 `callee` 不可调用时返回 undefined / The call result, or `undefined` when `js` is `NULL` or `callee` is not callable
hpe_js_call_value.note: 不捕获异常，与 `hpe_js_call` 不同 / Unlike `hpe_js_call`, it does not catch exceptions

hpe_js_set_module_loader.brief: 注册用于解析 `import` 的模块加载器 / Register the module loader used to resolve `import` specifiers

params.loader: 模块加载器回调（为 NULL 时清除并置零）/ Module loader callback; `NULL` clears it

hpe_js_set_current_dir.brief: 设置解析相对模块说明符的基准目录 / Set the base directory relative module specifiers resolve against
hpe_js_set_current_dir.note: 仅保存指针，不复制字符串 / Only the pointer is stored, the string is not copied

hpe_js_global_object.brief: 取回全局对象的原始对象指针 / Get the raw object pointer of the global object
hpe_js_global_object.return: 全局对象指针；`js` 为空时返回 NULL / The global object, or `NULL` when `js` is `NULL`
